metadata.title: Willmore Energy Estimates for Klein Bottles
metadata.abstract: In this note, we provide an estimate for the Willmore energy of Klein bottles in $\mathbb R^N$, building on the ideas of Li-Yau and Montiel-Ros for $2$-tori. In particular, we prove that the Willmore energy $\mathcal{W}(\phi)> 6\pi$ for any conformal branched immersion $\phi:\mathbb{K}^2_b\rightarrow \mathbb R^N$, where $\mathbb{K}^2_b$ is a flat Klein bottle with $0.350\lesssim b \lesssim 0.755$. This confirms partially a conjecture of Kusner. Moreover, for a flat immersion $\psi:\mathbb{K}^2_b\rightarrow \mathbb R^N$, we derive a lower bound of $\mathcal{W}(\psi)$, which confirms a conjecture of Hirsch-Mäder-Baumdicker for flat Klein bottles in $\mathbb R^N$. We also construct a smooth family of flat Klein bottles in $\mathbb R^5$, with Willmore energy between $6.912\pi$ and $8\pi$.
